title: mongodb-operator values
description: Dependency-wrapper for the upstream MongoDB Controllers for Kubernetes (MCK, chart `mongodb-kubernetes`), aliased to `operator`. Values pass through under `operator` — MCK's own `operator`/`community`/`registry` blocks therefore nest one level deeper (e.g. operator.operator.watchedResources).

global.title: Global values
global.description: Helm global values propagated to the upstream subchart.

operator.title: Upstream mongodb-kubernetes (MCK) passthrough
operator.description: Values forwarded to the upstream MongoDB Controllers for Kubernetes subchart. Krateo pins a lean community-only, Apache-2.0 posture (operator.operator.watchedResources=[mongodbcommunity], telemetry off, no cluster roles/webhook); the MongoDBCommunity instance CR is emitted by the ClickStack chart, not here.
